pages.text: Upgrade cards go in the $(item)Upgrades screen$(), opened with the arrow button in the top right of a farm. A farm has $(item)18 card slots$(), and holds each card only once.$(br2)You can also $(item)sneak and right-click$() a farm with a card in hand to install it.

Cards run in $(item)slot order$(). When two cards change the same drops, the first one wins.$(br2)A card can also be $(thing)refused$(): hold it over a slot and the tooltip explains why (see $(l:easy_farms:cards/restrictions)Card Restrictions$()).$(br2)Modpacks and other mods can add more cards: any item can become a card with a bit of data, and the same screens show them.
